 Chelsea vs Man United TV channel, live stream and kick-off time
 Manchester United face a tough test in the Premier League away at Chelsea
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Fasika Zelealem and Kasra Moradi Senior Sports Journalist 10:00, 31 Oct 2026 Chelsea take on Manchester United in an early kick-off (Image: Visionhaus, Visionhaus/Getty Images) 
 How to watch Chelsea vs Manchester United: 
 Date and kick-off time: The Premier League clash between Chelsea and Manchester United is set to take place on Saturday, October 31, at Stamford Bridge in west London. The match will begin in the early afternoon slot at 12.30pm UK time.
 UK television broadcast: Domestic live television coverage will be shown on TNT Sports 1 and TNT Sports Ultimate. The broadcast build-up will start at 11am UK time, providing viewers with 90 minutes of pre-match analysis, pitchside interviews and team news before kick off.
 UK streaming and online platforms: Fans in the UK can watch the fixture live online through the Discovery+ app and website with a TNT Sports subscription, or via the HBO Max app where available. Furthermore, Virgin Media television subscribers who have TNT Sports packages can access the live feed directly on mobile devices and tablets through the Virgin TV Go app.
 USA broadcast and streaming options: Viewers in the United States can access live linear coverage on USA Network, with an alternative Spanish-language broadcast available on Telemundo. Fans can stream the game online via the NBC Sports digital app, the Telemundo Deportes platform, or live-TV streaming services such as Fubo and Sling TV by signing in with active provider credentials.
 UK radio and audio commentary: Live national radio commentary will be available across the UK on talkSPORT. Fans can tune in via standard AM/DAB frequencies and the talkSPORT mobile app, or access live match audio through the official Chelsea and Manchester United apps.
